description: This file defines the ContentWrapper interface for content management in the OFBiz framework, including static utility methods for content type handling and encoding.

classes.name: ContentWrapper
classes.description: Interface defining methods and static utilities for content handling in OFBiz.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves content wrapped as StringWrapper based on contentTypeId and encoderType.

methods.name: getDefaultMimeTypeId
methods.description: Returns the default MIME type ID for content, with a fallback value.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue (GenericValue, String)
methods.description: Checks a model object for a field matching the contentTypeId and returns its value.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue (Delegator, String, EntityCondition, String, boolean)
methods.description: Retrieves a candidate field value from a specific entity identified by primary key, with optional caching.

methods.name: encodeContentValue
methods.description: Encodes a content string using the specified encoder type.
